footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Phillips 66: after $125M attributable to noncontrolling interests, $9.0M of preferred dividends. The income statement has no operating income line; it is shown here as revenue less the operating expense lines, with interest and other non-operating items below it.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue fell 6.1% to $136.6B in 2025. Gross margin was 15.0%, versus 10.7% a year earlier, and operating income rose 79.7% to $6.5B, a 4.7% margin.
Net income rose 2.1× to $4.4B, or $10.79 per share. Operating cash flow was $5.0B and free cash flow $2.7B, versus $2.3B; Phillips 66 returned $3.1B through dividends and buybacks.

spotlights.cap: Net income was $4.4B, or $10.79 per share.
spotlights.say: Net income was $4.4B, or $10.79 per share.
